items.title: Katie Britt's face as a Hawks/Hawkeyes perjury gotcha collapses
items.summary: At Jack Smith's Senate hearing, Sen. Eric Schmitt's perjury claim rested on texts he said put Smith at a Hawks game; it was the Iowa Hawkeyes. Katie Britt's open-mouthed stare beside him became a reaction GIF.
items.author: @sahilkapur

references.title: Sen. Katie Britt’s ‘look of utter horror’ as GOP colleague’s perjury accusation unravels during Jack Smith hearing goes viral
Senator behind viral Jack Smith got blunder doubles down when confronted over error

post.name: Sahil Kapur
post.text:
A phenomenal moment in the Senate.

Eric Schmitt, R-Mo., claims he has evidence Jack Smith went to a HAWKS game in Atlanta.

Smith denies it.

Schmitt declares he has busted Jack Smith for perjury.

Smith, vexed, says he went to HAWKEYES game in Maryland.
